versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "lottery-checker" tool for China Sports Lottery Super Lotto (大乐透) batch prize checking.
- Supports single or batch ticket input with user-friendly number format.
- Automatically generates detailed, visually appealing reports showing each ticket's prize status, prize distribution, jackpot, and sales figures.
- Provides JSON output option for programmatic access.
- Retrieves real-time draw results and prize data from the official China Sports Lottery API.
- Offers clear instructions, output examples, and the latest prize matching rules.
